name: Yasmeen Turayhi
reason: Too thin: her own site, innerknowingschool.com (read 4 Nov 2026), offers only two intuition programmes as waitlists with no price or dates, and otherwise one TEDx talk and a podcast; no base is published and no book could be confirmed (Open Library refused our connections). Her Shift role was hosting the Medical Intuition Summit, and her certification is in 'Intuition Medicine' (medical rule).
